name: Sagae (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sagae city emblem in red: a stylised crown-like device with three points above a swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Sagae, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 July 1955.

features.role: Sagae city emblem — a stylised crown-like device with three points above a swirl
